title: Management of federal learning

pse.problem: Inefficient and decentralized machine learning model training in wireless communication systems
pse.solution_function: Centralized federal learning process that allows multiple User Equipments (UE) to participate in a training configuration, with the server selecting UEs, Model Structure (MS), baseline Parameter Set (PS) for a predictive model, determining training parameters, and activating training rounds simultaneously across all participating UEs.
pse.solution_structure: Servers for federal learning process, User Equipments (UE), Model Repository (MR)
pse.solution_implementation: Server sends training configuration to UE, each UE trains predictive model locally according to the configuration and based on its data set, UE reports model parameters to server, server aggregates model parameters from all UEs and updates parameter set
pse.effect: Improved efficiency and consistency in machine learning model training across multiple UEs
